about: Backgrounds and professions as Deem tables. Orsino's backgroundModifier (data/catalog/orsino/backgrounds.json, generated) gives each one its scores, gold, class and gear; these tables say what it means in a Kyr world. backgroundKind puts every Orsino background in one kind; backgroundKindMeaning gives a kind's skills, gear and the channel an old acquaintance hears news through (the n-th background of a kind takes the kind's n-th contact line, round again); backgroundOverlay changes one background where it differs from its kind. Compiled into the catalog by BackgroundCatalog.
